{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data structure
print("Data shape:", trial_df.shape)
print("\nColumn names:", trial_df.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(trial_df.head())

# Check for missing values
print("\nMissing values:")
print(trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print("\nDuplicate rows:", trial_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check value counts for categorical variables
print("\nValue counts for `arm`:")
print(trial_df['arm'].value_counts())

print("\nValue counts for `severity`:")
print(trial_df['severity'].value_counts())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
print("\nSentinel values in `biomarker_baseline`:", trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())
print("\nSentinel values in `biomarker_final`:", trial_df['biomarker_final'].unique())

# Check distribution of biomarker values
print("\nBaseline biomarker summary:")
print(trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].describe())

print("\nFinal biomarker summary:")
print(trial_df['biomarker_final'].describe())"}
